comment: JSON projection of the decimation filter's rows in the ratified target specification, spec/modulator-adc.md section 1.1, for the digital partition's T1 item 6 not_applicable record. Every cell is copied verbatim from that table; spec/test_decimator_rows.py re-derives this file from the Markdown and fails when the two disagree or when the Markdown stops hashing to source.content_hash below. This file is a copy for machine grading, never the specification itself: a row is changed only in the Markdown, through a decision record under spec/decisions/.

rows.target: ≥ 90 dB in the alias bands `k·fout ± BW`, k = 1 … `fs/(2·fout)` (last clipped at `fs/2`), and ≥ 75 dB elsewhere from `fout − BW` to `fs/2`
rows.fallback: ≥ 80 dB in the alias bands (75 dB elsewhere)
rows.stretch: ≥ 100 dB in the alias bands (75 dB elsewhere)

rows.target: CIC order ≥ 3 (= modulator order + 1), then FIR to `fout`
rows.stretch: CIC order ≥ 4 if the modulator order rises
